blocks.html: Girders and roof trusses (other than joists) over garage areas regularly utilized for the repair of vehicles and over manufacturing floors or storage floors used for commercial purposes shall be capable of supporting, in addition to the specified live and wind loads, a concentrated live load of 2,000 pounds (907.2 kg) applied at any lower chord panel point for trusses, and at any point of the lower flange for girders.
